description: A hanging bathrobe seen flat from the front: a wide shawl collar crossing into a deep V, two sleeves falling from dropped shoulders, and a horizontal belt across the waist with a knot and two short tails hanging below it. The skirt of the robe continues straight down to a flat hem.

A straight-sided beer stein with a rounded rectangular handle on its right, a head of foam bulging over the rim as a scalloped cap, and a horizontal line under the foam separating head from beer. Two short vertical strokes inside the body read as the glass facets.

A single open-end wrench laid on a diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. The head at the top opens into a two-pronged C jaw; the handle runs down as a parallel-sided shaft and ends in a flat, angled butt.

An isometric cube at the top, drawn as a hexagon outline with a three-way Y join marking its front vertical and two top edges. A stem drops from the cube to a horizontal bus, and three short legs drop from the bus to three equal circles in a row — a parent node distributed to three children.

A folded paper dart flying up and to the right, drawn as a single outline: a long swept leading edge from the nose at upper-right down to the left wingtip, a notched tail cut into the trailing edge, and the centre fold running from nose to the notch so the near wing reads as a separate triangle.

A single-deck bus in side profile facing right, with a long rounded-rectangle body, a raked windscreen at the front, a horizontal waistline under the windows, three passenger windows plus a driver's window along the top, and two wheels hanging below the body.

A small sailboat: a U-shaped hull with a flared, flat-topped gunwale, a vertical mast rising from its centre, and one triangular sail with a curved, bellied leech filling the space to the right of the mast. The mast tip pokes above the sail.
A sleeveless A-line dress hanging front-on: two shoulder straps meeting a scooped neckline, a fitted bodice narrowing to a waist seam, and a flared skirt that widens to a scalloped hem.

A palm tree on a small island: a slightly curved trunk rising from a domed mound of sand, topped by a crown of arcing fronds spreading in several directions. A wavy waterline runs across the base of the mound.
A retro broadcast microphone standing on a desk: a tall rounded-rectangle capsule with three horizontal grille bars across it, a short vertical stem below, and a wide flat base bar.
